::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 5th 1882  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell /8
:::

My dear [Mrs Wynyard](people/person_1575.qmd)[^1]

I am sorry to say I cannot accept your kind invitation as I am going from home on Monday for four or five days. I did not come home last night till too late for the post, so that I could not answer sooner

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: A neighbour, the wife of a retired Bengal Civil Servant.
